summary.share_gate: createShareLinkAction page select now includes deletedAt; `!page || page.deletedAt` returns { error: "Page not found." } — same fail-closed wording/style as loadShareableForm ("Form not found.", folds trashed into not-found). Gate sits before permission checks' revalidation needs, before ensurePageShortCode, and covers both create and existing-link-update paths.
summary.revoke_approach: DELETE (ShareLink has no revocation fields in schema.prisma — matches existing revokeShareLinkAction which uses deleteMany). archivePageAction now wraps the subtree deletedAt/isArchived updateMany + prisma.shareLink.deleteMany({ where: { pageId: { in: ids }, viewId: null } }) in prisma.$transaction([...]). Deliberate small extension over the item's literal `where: { pageId, viewId: null }`: revoke uses pageId: { in: ids } so page-level links on the WHOLE trashed subtree die (children are also trashed and their /s URLs would otherwise stay live). Form links (viewId set) untouched.
summary.secrets_cache: No cache to invalidate: src/lib/secrets.ts share-unlock cookie is stateless HMAC verification (fail-closed on missing AUTH_SECRET) and the decode is gated by the DB link lookup; compareSharePassword looks up the token in DB (row gone → false). unlockAttempts rate-limit map keys on token; stale entries fail closed (no row → wrong-password). Existing revokeShareLinkAction invalidates nothing beyond the row either — archived path mirrors it. Pinned by test: attemptShareUnlock on a revoked token → { status: "wrong-password" }.
summary.restore: restorePageAction untouched — link already deleted at archive time, so nothing silently revives; no auto-reshare added, per instructions.
